narrative.title: Typical vs slammed
narrative.summary: Compared with Typical, Slammed shows higher synthetic task pressure (+369 tasks) and more deferred synthetic work (+320 tasks). The queue-depth signal is larger (+11) while approximate walking load also rises (+10204 feet). This is an operational comparison only using synthetic, seeded scenario output.
limitations: Synthetic tasks use explicit assumptions and seeded generation.
nonClaims: Not based on real patient, staff, EHR, or hospital data.
